====================================================================================================
Casts between strings and numbers, booleans and binary

Each case runs as CAST. TRY_CAST follows a case only when CAST fails at runtime, to show which rows
become NULL. Where CAST succeeds, TRY_CAST is checked to return the same values and is not listed;
where CAST fails type checking, TRY_CAST is checked to fail it too.
====================================================================================================


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Numbers and strings

A string parses as a number, and fails when it is not a number of the type or does not fit. A number
renders as text.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | CAST('foo' AS UINT64)
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ invalid digit found in string while evaluating function `to_uint64('foo')` in expr `CAST('foo' AS UInt64)`



ast            : TRY_CAST('foo' AS UINT64)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST('foo' AS UInt64)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<String>("foo" AS UInt64 NULL)
optimized expr : NULL
output type    : UInt64 NULL
output domain  : {NULL}
output         : NULL


error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | CAST('1foo' AS INT32)
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ invalid digit found in string while evaluating function `to_int32('1foo')` in expr `CAST('1foo' AS Int32)`



ast            : TRY_CAST('1foo' AS INT32)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Booleans and strings

`true` and `false` in any letter case, `1` and `0` parse as booleans; other strings, such as `t`,
fail. A boolean renders as `true` or `false`.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | CAST('t' AS BOOLEAN)
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ cannot parse to type `BOOLEAN` while evaluating function `to_boolean('t')` in expr `CAST('t' AS Boolean)`



ast            : TRY_CAST('t' AS BOOLEAN)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST('t' AS Boolean)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<String>("t" AS Boolean NULL)
optimized expr : NULL
output type    : Boolean NULL
output domain  : {NULL}
output         : NULL


error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | CAST('f' AS BOOLEAN)
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ cannot parse to type `BOOLEAN` while evaluating function `to_boolean('f')` in expr `CAST('f' AS Boolean)`



ast            : TRY_CAST('f' AS BOOLEAN)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST('f' AS Boolean)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<String>("f" AS Boolean NULL)
optimized expr : NULL

output domain  : {NULL}
output         : NULL

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Binary and strings

A string converts to its UTF-8 bytes, and the bytes convert back to the same string.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


ast            : CAST('Abc' AS BINARY)
raw expr       : CAST('Abc' AS Binary)
checked expr   : CAST<String>("Abc" AS Binary)
optimized expr : 416263
output type    : Binary
output domain  : Undefined
output         : 416263


ast            : CAST('Dobrý den' AS BINARY)
raw expr       : CAST('Dobrý den' AS Binary)
checked expr   : CAST<String>("Dobrý den" AS Binary)
optimized expr : 446F6272C3BD2064656E
output type    : Binary
output domain  : Undefined
output         : 446F6272C3BD2064656E


ast            : CAST('ß😀山' AS BINARY)
raw expr       : CAST('ß😀山' AS Binary)
checked expr   : CAST<String>("ß😀山" AS Binary)
optimized expr : C39FF09F9880E5B1B1
output type    : Binary
output domain  : Undefined
output         : C39FF09F9880E5B1B1


error:
